CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
March 22, 2022 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF IRENA GUILMETTE FOR HER DEDICATED SERVICE TO THE COMMUNITY - It is recommended the City Council present Irena Guilmette with a plaque in recognition of her service to the La Mirada community.
5.1 Recognition of Irena Guilmette
5.2
RECOGNITION OF THE TRAFFIC CONTROL BOX ART CONTEST WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council recognize the 2022 Traffic Control Box Art Contest winners and present them with Certificates of Recognition and a $250 contest prize.
5.2 Recognition of Traffic Control Box Art Contest Winners
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of March 8, 2022 and the regular City Council meeting of March 8, 2022.
7.1 Minutes of 3-8-22 SS
7.1 Minutes of 3-8-22 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated March 22, 2022 in the total amount of $1,192,018.02.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
MAINTENANCE OF TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICES AND LIGHTING - VALLEY VIEW AVENUE AND STAGE ROAD, MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT WITH THE CITY OF SANTA FE SPRINGS - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement between the Cities of La Mirada and Santa Fe Springs for the maintenance of traffic control devices and lighting at Valley View Avenue and Stage Road; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional costs as required for actual costs for the repair/replacement of streetlights and pedestrian walkway lights, extraordinary maintenance costs, and energy costs, as noted in the agreement.
7.3 Mtc of Traffic Control Devices & Lighting
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-05, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL AREA 3 - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, AND JOINT PARTICIPATION AGREEMENT WITH THE CITY OF BUENA PARK - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-05, Neighborhood Slurry Seal Area 3; approve the Joint Participation Agreement with the City of Buena Park and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.4 CIP No. 2021-05
7.5
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING FEBRUARY 2022 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending February 2022.
7.5 Investment Report
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 22-06 PROVIDING FOR THE APPOINTMENT TO THE CITY OF LA MIRADA COUNCIL DISTRICT 1 OFFICE THAT WAS TO BE ELECTED ON TUESDAY, JUNE 7, 2022 – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-06 providing for the appointment to the City of La Mirada Council District 1 Office that was to be elected on Tuesday, June 7, 2022.
8.1 Resolution No. 22-06
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 22-07 WAIVING THE FORMAL BID PROCESS AND AUTHORIZING THE PURCHASE OF TRANSIT VEHICLES – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-07 waiving the formal bid process and authorizing the purchase of transit vehicles.
8.2 Resolution No. 22-07
